title: SHIFT(hold) + NUMBER not working to switch between Fancy zones personal layouts

actions.label: Explain current FancyZones quick-switch chord
actions.note: Draft a maintainer scope note explaining the supported quick-layout-switch gesture.

comment.body: I re-checked the current FancyZones implementation, and the behavior you are seeing matches the supported input model today: **quick layout switching during drag now requires Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit**. The old Shift+digit flow was intentionally removed because it could steal number-key input from applications while FancyZones was tracking a drag. The current source and UI tests both codify the Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit chord, so I would treat this as product-direction feedback about restoring the old gesture rather than as a new regression fix.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones no longer supports Shift+digit quick layout switching while a drag is active; the supported chord is Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit to avoid stealing number input from apps.
known_information: The reporter says the old Shift+number drag flow worked before v0.101.2362.0 and that Win+Alt+Ctrl+number still works now.
Multiple commenters confirm the same behavior on the latest update.
FancyZones.cpp contains explicit logic that only changes layouts when Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit is pressed, both while dragging and while not dragging.
The .Next UI test for quick layout switching states that the historical digit-only wording is obsolete.
inferences: The missing Shift+digit behavior is currently a deliberate compatibility trade-off, not a silent code-path break.
Reintroducing the old gesture would require a product decision about whether stealing number keys during drag is acceptable again.
issue_context.analysis: Because current source and tests codify the new chord, this is not actionable bug-fix work for the dashboard. The right maintainer action is a scope note, not an implementation design.
initial_investigation: Reviewed FancyZones.cpp quick-layout-switch handling around ApplyQuickLayout and drag-state checks.
Reviewed FancyZones.UITests.Next/LayoutApplyHotKeyTests.cs, which now tests Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit during drag and calls the older checklist wording obsolete.
Checked recent FancyZones history and found input-state hardening work in the same area.

judgment.rationale: Current FancyZones code and UI tests show that digit-only layout switching while dragging was deliberately retired; the supported quick-layout chord during drag is now Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit.
evidence: src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp now requires `win && ctrl && alt && digitPressed != -1` even while dragging.
The adjacent code comment says this requirement prevents accidental layout switches when drag state is stuck and number keys would otherwise be stolen from applications.
src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZones.UITests.Next/LayoutApplyHotKeyTests.cs explicitly documents that the old “digit only” wording is obsolete and tests Win+Ctrl+Alt+digit during drag.
Recent history includes commit b5069b154 (`[FancyZones] Re-seed Shift state at drag start`) in the same area, reinforcing that this input model has been intentionally reworked.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a scope clarification that Shift+digit during drag is no longer the supported gesture and that the issue should be handled as product-direction feedback if the old behavior is desired back.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported behavior matches an intentional input-model change rather than an accidental regression that already has a narrowly scoped code fix.
